name: You can't teach an old dog new tricks

meaning.zh:
“你无法教年老的狗新把戏” 或 “本性难移”。

这个短语的起源可以追溯到16世纪，最早出现在英国的谚语中。它的意思是说，老年人或者习惯根深蒂固的人很难接受新的思想或改变行为。即使经过训练，也很难让这些人学会新技能或者改变他们的习惯。
meaning.en: This phrase can be traced back to the 16th century, first appearing in English proverbs. It means that it's difficult for elderly people or those with deeply ingrained habits to accept new ideas or change their behavior. Even with training, it's challenging to make these individuals learn new skills or change their ways.

lines.en: My grandfather refuses to use a smartphone; you know what they say, *you can't teach an old dog new tricks*.
lines.zh: 我爷爷拒绝使用智能手机，大家都知道，本性难移。

lines.en: After years of doing things his way, *you can't teach an old dog new tricks*.
lines.zh: 多年如一日地按自己的方式做事，他很难改掉这个习惯。

lines.en: Jane tried to get her dad to eat healthier, but *you can't teach an old dog new tricks*.
lines.zh: 简试图让她爸爸吃得更健康，但本性难移。
